159	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
160	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
161	    ap.add_argument("game_id", type=int)
162	    ap.add_argument("--no-submit", action="store_true")
163	    ap.add_argument("--case-dir", type=Path, help="skip get_case.sh and use this folder")
164	    # One pass by default. The fast pass was insurance from when the full pass ran on a
165	    # slower model (gpt-5.6-sol, 7-35 s); now that everything is gpt-5.6-terra the full pass
166	    # lands in 2-7 s and the second call bought a duplicate answer, not safety. --fast brings
167	    # it back if a case ever runs long again.
168	    ap.add_argument("--fast", dest="fast", action="store_true", help="also run the fast safety pass first")
169	    ap.add_argument("--no-fast", dest="fast", action="store_false", help="skip the fast first pass (default)")
170	    ap.set_defaults(fast=False)
171	    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
172	    try:
173	        llm.provider()  # fail before we touch the game if no LLM key is configured
174	    except RuntimeError as e:
175	        print(f"ERROR: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
176	        return 2
177	
178	    t0 = time.time()
179	    record: dict = {"game_id": args.game_id, "started_at": t0, "submissions": []}
180	    dry = args.no_submit or args.case_dir is not None
181	    run_path = ROOT / "runs" / (f"dry_game_{args.game_id:02d}.json" if dry else f"game_{args.game_id:02d}.json")
182	    run_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
183	
184	    def save() -> None:
185	        run_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str))
186	
187	    # ---- IN  (get_case.sh polls the key until the game opens; the 60 s clock starts then)
188	    if args.case_dir:
189	        case_dir = args.case_dir
190	    else:
191	        log("waiting for the key / decrypting ...", t0)
192	        case_dir = fetch_case(args.game_id)
193	        t0 = time.time()  # restart the clock: the window opened when the key appeared
194	        record["key_obtained_at"] = t0
195	    log(f"case at {case_dir}", t0)
196	
197	    # ---- EXTRACT
198	    case = load_case(case_dir, args.game_id)
199	    log(f"{len(case['items'])} parsed line item(s), {len(case['images'])} image(s)", t0)
200	    record["case"] = {k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != "images"}
201	    record["case"]["n_images"] = len(case["images"])
202	    save()
203	
204	    def do_submit(rows: list[dict], tag: str) -> None:
205	        entry = {"tag": tag, "at_s": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "rows": rows}
206	        if args.no_submit:
207	            entry["response"] = "skipped (--no-submit)"
208	        else:
209	            try:
210	                entry["response"] = submit(args.game_id, rows)
211	            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
212	                entry["error"] = str(e)
213	        record["submissions"].append(entry)
214	        save()
215	        log(f"submitted [{tag}]: " + ", ".join(f"#{r['index']} a={r['charge_price']} b={r['acceptance_limit']}" for r in rows), t0)
216	
217	    # ---- MODEL: ONE pass. No votes, and no fast safety pass unless --fast is given.
218	    full_model = os.environ.get("C2F_MODEL")
219	    fast_model = os.environ.get("C2F_FAST_MODEL") or "gpt-5.6-terra"
220	
221	    def run_model(model: str | None, timeout: float, strict: bool, c: dict):
222	        return llm.estimate(c, timeout=timeout, model=model, strict=strict)
223	
224	    def run_model_only(model: str | None, timeout: float, c: dict, only: list[int] | None, sweep: bool):
225	        """One full-pass chunk: whole case in the prompt, answer narrowed to `only`."""
226	        return llm.estimate(c, timeout=timeout, model=model, strict=False, only=only, sweep=sweep)
227	
228	    tags: dict = {}
229	    # fast + up to MAX_CHUNKS full chunks run at once; a pool of 2 would serialise the
230	    # chunks and defeat the split. (The policy digest lane is gone, so no slot for it.)
231	    ex = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=(1 if args.fast else 0) + MAX_CHUNKS)
232	    try:
233	        # Fast pass and full pass start together; the fast pass is the safety net and must
234	        # not wait for anything. dict(case) so the two passes never share a mutable dict.
235	        if args.fast:
236	            tags[ex.submit(run_model, fast_model, FAST_TIMEOUT_S, True, dict(case))] = "fast"
237	
238	        budget = max(MIN_MODEL_S, DEADLINE_S - (time.time() - t0))
239	
240	        # Split the full pass. One long call is all-or-nothing: games 10 and 15 both lost the
241	        # entire full result to the deadline and shipped fast-pass prices. Chunked, the round's
242	        # latency is the slowest chunk and a chunk that misses costs only its own items.
243	        fast_landed = next((f for f in tags if tags[f] == "fast" and f.done()), None)
244	        fast_peek = None
245	        if fast_landed is not None:
246	            try:
247	                fast_peek = fast_landed.result(timeout=0)[0]
248	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - only used to order the chunks
249	                fast_peek = None
250	        parsed_idx = sorted({int(it["index"]) for it in case.get("items", [])})
251	        chunks = plan_chunks(parsed_idx, fast_peek) if parsed_idx else [None]
252	        asked: dict[str, list[int]] = {}  # tag -> the POS numbers that chunk was asked for
253	        for n, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
254	            tag = "full" if len(chunks) == 1 else f"full[{n + 1}/{len(chunks)}]"
255	            # The LAST chunk sweeps for POS numbers the parser missed - not the first.
256	            # A sweeping chunk is not really a chunk: it is told to price every POS number in
257	            # the invoice that is absent from its list, so it answers for the whole invoice and
258	            # takes whole-invoice time. Measured on case 15 (29 items, chunk [1..10], two runs
259	            # each, run concurrently so load is equal): sweep 32-36 s returning 29 items,
260	            # no sweep 17-28 s returning 10. Carrying that ~12 s on chunk 0 put it on the
261	            # BIGGEST-stake items (plan_chunks ranks them first), so the lines worth most sat
262	            # at the 0/0 placeholder longest - and games 10 and 15 were both lost to the clock.
263	            # On the last, smallest, lowest-stake chunk the same insurance costs the least.
264	            tags[ex.submit(run_model_only, full_model, budget, dict(case), chunk,
265	                           n == len(chunks) - 1)] = tag
266	            asked[tag] = list(chunk) if chunk else list(parsed_idx)
267	        if len(chunks) > 1:
268	            log(f"full pass split into {len(chunks)} chunks: {chunks}", t0)
269	
270	        full_tags = {t for t in tags.values() if t.startswith("full")}
271	        full_items: dict[int, dict] = {}  # accumulates across chunks
272	        pending, full_seen = set(tags), set()
273	        while pending and full_seen != full_tags:
274	            remaining = DEADLINE_S - (time.time() - t0)
275	            if remaining <= 0:
276	                log("deadline reached, stop waiting for the model", t0)
277	                break
278	            done, pending = wait(pending, timeout=remaining, return_when=FIRST_COMPLETED)
279	            # if both landed in the same batch, submit fast first so full is the last write
280	            for f in sorted(done, key=lambda f: tags[f].startswith("full")):
281	                tag = tags[f]
282	                is_full = tag.startswith("full")
283	                try:
284	                    out, meta = f.result()
285	                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
286	                    record[f"model_{tag}_error"] = str(e)
287	                    log(f"model [{tag}] failed: {e}", t0)
288	                    if is_full:
289	                        full_seen.add(tag)  # a dead chunk must not stall the others
290	                    continue
291	                record[f"model_{tag}"] = {"meta": {k: v for k, v in meta.items() if k != "raw"}, "output": out}
292	                log(f"model [{tag}] {meta['model']} answered in {meta['seconds']}s", t0)
293	                for w in meta.get("validation_errors", []):
294	                    log(f"model [{tag}] INVALID: {w}", t0)
295	
296	                if is_full:
297	                    full_seen.add(tag)
298	                    # THIS is a missing item: a POS number we put in front of the model and
299	                    # asked it to price, that is absent from its answer. Distinct from a line
300	                    # a later chunk still owns, and the only one worth shouting about - the
301	                    # parse exists so that a silent skip cannot pass for a priced line.
302	                    answered = {int(it["index"]) for it in out.get("items", [])
303	                                if str(it.get("index", "")).lstrip("-").isdigit()}
304	                    skipped = [i for i in asked.get(tag, []) if i not in answered]
305	                    if skipped:
306	                        record.setdefault("skipped_by_model", []).extend(
307	                            {"tag": tag, "index": i} for i in skipped)
308	                        log(f"model [{tag}] SKIPPED {len(skipped)} item(s) it was asked to "
309	                            f"price: {skipped} - they stay at the 0/0 placeholder", t0)
310	                    # Accumulate: each chunk refines its own items, and the accumulated set is
311	                    # re-priced and submitted in FULL every time. Submitting only the chunk's
312	                    # rows would rely on the server keeping omitted lines, and the handbook is
313	                    # ambiguous there ("upsert" vs "omitted line items use the game defaults").
314	                    # A wrong guess resets everything to 0/0, so we never test it under a clock.
315	                    for it in out.get("items", []):
316	                        try:
317	                            full_items[int(it["index"])] = it
318	                        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
319	                            continue
320	                    merged = {"items": list(full_items.values())}
321	                    fast_out = record.get("model_fast", {}).get("output")
322	                    # unrefined items fall back to the fast pass rather than to nothing
323	                    if fast_out:
324	                        for it in fast_out.get("items", []):
325	                            try:
326	                                i = int(it["index"])
327	                            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
328	                                continue
329	                            if i not in full_items:
330	                                merged["items"].append(it)
331	                    out, record["estimate"] = merged, merged
332	                    other_output = fast_out
333	
334	                    # SUBMIT AFTER EVERY CHUNK. Last write wins on the server and only the
335	                    # state at close is scored, so an intermediate row that is still a
336	                    # placeholder costs nothing as long as a later chunk overwrites it - while
337	                    # a board that is never empty survives a crash, a hang, or a clock we
338	                    # misjudged. We used to hold until every parsed item had an estimate; with
339	                    # the fast pass gone that meant one slow chunk could ship NOTHING.
340	                    #
341	                    # The placeholder for an item no chunk has reached yet is 0/0, and 0/0 is
342	                    # the right ignorant guess: b=0 wrongly rejects fair charges at 0.5a extra
343	                    # each, while b=inf accepts fraud up to the cap c >= 4t. Rejecting is the
344	                    # cheaper mistake to make blind, so an unreached line is a safe line.
345	                    have = set(full_items) | {
346	                        int(it["index"])
347	                        for it in (fast_out or {}).get("items", [])
348	                        if str(it.get("index", "")).lstrip("-").isdigit()
349	                    }
350	                    missing = [i for i in parsed_idx if i not in have]
351	                    if missing:
352	                        log(
353	                            f"[{tag}] submitting with {len(missing)} item(s) still at the 0/0 "
354	                            f"placeholder ({missing[:6]}{'...' if len(missing) > 6 else ''}) - "
355	                            "a later chunk overwrites them",
356	                            t0,
357	                        )
358	                else:
359	                    record["estimate"] = out  # fast is the fallback until a chunk lands
360	                    other_output = None
361	
362	                other_by_idx: dict[int, dict] = {}
363	                for it in (other_output or {}).get("items", []):
364	                    try:
365	                        other_by_idx[int(it["index"])] = it
366	                    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
367	                        continue
368	                resolved, fatal = resolve_invalid_items(merge_estimates(case, out), other_by_idx)
369	                for bad in fatal:
370	                    log(f"model [{tag}] FATAL: item {bad['index']}: {bad['reason']}", t0)
371	                if fatal:
372	                    record.setdefault("fatal_items", []).extend({**b, "tag": tag} for b in fatal)
373	                rows = price_all(resolved, other_output=other_output)
374	                record[f"priced_{tag}"] = rows
375	                do_submit(rows, tag)
376	
377	        if pending:
378	            # deadline hit (or full landed first and fast is still out there) with a call still
379	            # in flight - it may finish after we've returned, but its result is lost either way.
380	            # Record which pass that was so a $0-fast-only submission is visible in the log, not
381	            # silently indistinguishable from "the full pass agreed with the fast one".
382	            still = sorted(tags[f] for f in pending)
383	            record["timed_out"] = still
384	            log(f"deadline reached with {still} still in flight - abandoning, using best submission so far", t0)
385	    finally:
386	        ex.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
387	
388	    # Last-ditch flush. The hold above waits for every parsed item to have an estimate before
389	    # submitting, which used to be safe because the fast pass had already put rows on the board.
390	    # With one pass there is nothing behind it: a deadline hit while holding would ship NOTHING.
391	    # Partial rows beat silence - the items a dead chunk never covered go out at 0/0 either way.
392	    if not record["submissions"] and (record.get("estimate") or {}).get("items"):
393	        log("deadline hit while holding - submitting the partial estimate rather than nothing", t0)
394	        try:
395	            resolved, _ = resolve_invalid_items(merge_estimates(case, record["estimate"]), {})
396	            do_submit(price_all(resolved, other_output=None), "partial")
397	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - a broken partial must not mask the real failure
398	            log(f"partial submission failed: {e}", t0)
399	
400	    if not record["submissions"]:
401	        log("NO SUBMISSION MADE - the model pass failed", t0)
402	        save()
403	        return 1
404	    record["finished_at_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
405	    save()
406	    log(f"done. log: {run_path.relative_to(ROOT)}", t0)
407	    return 0
408	
409	
410	if __name__ == "__main__":
411	    sys.exit(main())

input.old_string: STRICT_SUFFIX = "\n\nIMPORTANT: you are the quick first pass. When in doubt whether an item is covered or related, answer covered=false (we can be corrected later, but a wrong acceptance pays a fraud)."
input.new_string:
STRICT_SUFFIX = "\n\nIMPORTANT: you are the quick first pass. When in doubt whether an item is covered or related, answer covered=false (we can be corrected later, but a wrong acceptance pays a fraud)."

# ---- whale resampling: median-of-k on the items that decide the round -------------------
# One sample of t_mid on a dominant item swings the round: game 41's robbery compensation
# came out 8,000 on one run and 6,000 on the next (same prompt), a +-65k difference in net.
# For items whose stake crosses RESAMPLE_T we ask the model again (answer narrowed via
# `only`, whole case still in the prompt) and combine per item: majority coverage, median
# t values, and a between-sample sigma that widens the pricing belief exactly when the
# samples disagree.
RESAMPLE_T = float(os.environ.get("C2F_RESAMPLE_T") or 1000.0)
RESAMPLE_K = int(os.environ.get("C2F_RESAMPLE_K") or 2)  # extra samples (total = 1 + K)


def _stake(it: dict) -> float:
    for k in ("t_mid", "t_if_covered"):
        try:
            v = float(it.get(k) or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if v > 0:
            return v
    return 0.0


def _median(xs: list[float]) -> float:
    xs = sorted(xs)
    n = len(xs)
    return xs[n // 2] if n % 2 else 0.5 * (xs[n // 2 - 1] + xs[n // 2])


def resample_whales(case: dict, out: dict, *, k: int = RESAMPLE_K, threshold: float = RESAMPLE_T,
                    timeout: float = 25.0, model: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Return `out` with every whale item replaced by the sample-combined version.

    Best effort: a failed resample leaves the original single-sample item untouched."""
    import math
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    big = [int(it["index"]) for it in out.get("items", [])
           if str(it.get("index", "")).lstrip("-").isdigit() and _stake(it) >= threshold]
    if not big or k <= 0:
        return out
    samples: list[dict[int, dict]] = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=k) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(estimate, dict(case), timeout=timeout, model=model, only=list(big)) for _ in range(k)]

                extra, _meta = f.result()
                samples.append({int(it["index"]): it for it in extra.get("items", [])
                                if str(it.get("index", "")).lstrip("-").isdigit()})
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed resample must never sink the round
                continue
    if not samples:
        return out
    merged_items = []
    for it in out.get("items", []):
        try:
            idx = int(it["index"])
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            merged_items.append(it)
            continue
        if idx not in big:
            merged_items.append(it)
            continue
        pool = [it] + [s[idx] for s in samples if idx in s]
        votes = [bool(p.get("covered", False)) and bool(p.get("related", True)) for p in pool]
        covered = sum(votes) * 2 > len(votes)  # majority; tie -> not covered (the cheap side)
        agree = [p for p, v in zip(pool, votes) if v == covered] or pool
        combined = dict(agree[0] if agree[0] is not it else it)
        for key in ("t_low", "t_mid", "t_high", "t_if_covered"):
            vals = [float(p.get(key) or 0) for p in agree if float(p.get(key) or 0) > 0]
            if vals:
                combined[key] = round(_median(vals), 2)
        combined["covered"], combined["related"] = covered, covered or bool(it.get("related", True))
        mids = [float(p.get("t_mid") or 0) for p in pool if float(p.get("t_mid") or 0) > 0]
        if len(mids) >= 2:
            combined["_sample_sigma"] = round((math.log(max(mids)) - math.log(min(mids))) / 2, 4)
